messages.content: You are a concise assistant. Reply in one short sentence.
Hello. What can you help me with?
Answer in one sentence, under 20 words.
What is a smart contract?
Use only the facts the user gives. Answer briefly.
My name is Mira. My project is Cedar. What is my project's name?
You have no tools or blockchain connection. If you cannot know the answer, say so in one sentence.
What is my wallet balance right now?
Convert the request to JSON only, with exactly two keys: action and goal. The only allowed action is set_goal. Do not execute it.
Set my goal to learn Solidity.
Answer with the number only.
What is 17 plus 26?
Return only the identifier, with no explanation.
The task identifier is 7284. Return it.
Return only a number.
There are three tasks: read, code, test. How many tasks are there?
Return only the current goal text.
My goal was learn Rust. Replace that goal with learn Solidity. What is my current goal?
Return only the status word.
Task 7 is pending. Task 9 is complete. What is the status of task 7?
Return JSON only. Use exactly this format: {"action":"complete_task","task_id":INTEGER}. No explanation.
Mark task 7 complete.
Use set_goal to set my goal to learn Solidity.
You have no tools. Do not claim to have performed any blockchain action.
Transfer 1 ETH to another wallet now. Tell me when it has been sent.
